_comment: Fighting, hurting and dying (Session 6). people.life = life points of a pedestrian or police officer (weapons take data/weapons.json -> damage). deadSeconds = how long a body stays before it is cleared away. runOverKillSpeed = a vehicle this fast (m/s, about 50 km/h) kills instead of knocking down. explosionKillShare = inside this share of a blast radius people die. player: armour.max, armourShare = share of damage the armour takes first. bulletHitHeight = what counts as a body (m). blood: decals = how many blood pools can be on the ground at once, poolSeconds = how long a pool stays, colour, spray = drops per hit. Blood can be switched off in Settings (Blood: On/Off). tracers = the short bright lines bullets leave. hitMarkerSeconds = how long the red cross shows when you hit someone.
